conclusion.proven: Two actual pre-stop delivery deadlines failed for the combat actor. Server immediate-handler and movement-admission counters independently show multi-second requests; public input queue-residence spans align with the failed send times. The original probe remains failed.
notProven: No exact connection/request attribution in slow-stage whitelist.
No root cause is established for why the serial connection loop did not receive the queued input sooner.
Low aggregate process CPU/IO and short sampled zoneWork do not prove all locks or every Zone command were fast; zoneWork excludes several waits/command/snapshot paths.
No supplied evidence identifies spectator JSON/IO, disk saturation, a physical-host limit or a full workload-capacity ceiling.
conclusion.nextStep: Keep formal04 frozen. Use the separate source-only queue/serial-loop audit to choose bounded instrumentation or a concrete fix; do not relax900ms/2s/rolling gates or reclassify the timeouts.
